description: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data shows NTP (port 123) seen open on an IPv4 address. Passive and possibly old; the monlist amplification check itself is not run, so this cannot say whether monlist is enabled. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_ssh_banner_audit when you need From Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data: whether TCP; security_bimi_record_audit when you need to read a domain's BIMI record: whether it is published. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_ntp_monlist_audit
title: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data
